title: Tatlo, dalawa, isa
writer: Tony Perez, Mario O'Hara, Angela Barrios
actors: Jay Ilagan, Perla Bautista, Laurice Guillen
plot: (Tagalog with English subtitles) Filipino cinema lenged, Lino Brocka, directs this compilation of three intimate stories about the perseverance of hope featuring a drug addict, an abandoned daughter and a repressed catholic.
